query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM guild_projection_state s
                 JOIN bot_instances b ON b.instance_id = s.owner_instance_id
                WHERE s.guild_id = $1
                  AND s.presence_synced_at IS NOT NULL
                  AND b.state <> 'stopped'
                  AND b.heartbeat_at > now() - interval '120 seconds'
           ) AS "available!"
